profile.headline: Software Engineer at ViaSat Inc.
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over 20 years of experience in the Broadband, Wireless, Telecommunications, and Aerospace industries.  Principle strengths include Software development and maintenance, Embedded Software/Hardware integration, Database Design, Test Automation, and System Testing.  Self-motivated team player with exceptional analytical and communication skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a Test Automation Framework using the Eclipse IDE and Python.  Increased Test coverage and reduced Software Release test cycle times.
Responsibilities included:
    - Developed and maintained the test cases for new and existing product features. 
    - Automated test cases in Python to run on Windows or Linux.
    - Performed manual test cases and ran automated tests for product Software Release cycles.
    - Reported and characterized product software bugs found as a result of testing.
    - Worked closely with software developers on new features and provided integration test support.

positions.title: Contractor, Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Analyzed and developed a Test Plan for embedded Linux based network router products. Started documenting test cases for existing features.  Participated in one product Software Release test cycle.  Automated the daily software build and test suite using Bash shell and Python scripts that execute on a Linux server.

positions.title: Contractor, Phy Systems Engineering
positions.description:
Modified the following components of an existing Test Automation framework for a new product line:

     - Main Test Automation application written in C.  Test case and test algorithm TCL Scripts.  
     - Test Fixture Software application and DLL (.NET, C#).  Added NUnit to debug test the software.

Successfully performed initial test cases and completed the assignment.

positions.title: Staff Systems Test Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained a Software Test Automation application and infrastructure.  It was used in the System Test and Production Test of Entropic Multimedia over Coax (MoCA) reference designs and systems.  Lab Windows CVI, C

- Created and maintained Test scripts. TCL
- Developed Test plans and Test cases.
- Performed System Test and verification.  
- Designed and implemented a database application. SQL Server, C# .NET, Visual Basic

positions.title: Software Engineer III, Software Engineering/Satellite Test Group
positions.description:
Software Engineering
- Developed Software for Test Automation infrastructure and tools. C# .Net, C
- Embedded Software maintenance. C, Assembly Language

Satellite Test Group
- Created Test Plans and Test Cases. Performed Testing and debugging.
